lines: <php max-version="8.2"> in appinfo/info.xml is below PHP 8.3, the newest PHP Nextcloud 28 runs on.
A server on PHP 8.3 refuses to enable the app: Nextcloud holds <php max-version> against the PHP it runs on. Raise it to 8.3, or remove it and let the server range decide.
